plugins.cameraPermission: Parent Patch uses your camera to scan baby food barcodes and add photos or videos to your posts.

plugins.photosPermission: Parent Patch needs access to your photo library so you can add photos and videos to posts, journal entries, and your baby's profile.
plugins.microphonePermission: Parent Patch needs microphone access to record audio when you post a video.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Parent Patch needs background location to detect when you've stopped driving, even if the app isn't open, so it can remind you to check the back seat.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Parent Patch checks your driving speed to remind you to check the back seat when you stop.
